gates.K0_A: A private Kaggle script kernel starts and finishes without browser interaction
gates.K0_B: nvidia-smi reports exactly two Tesla T4 GPUs; Julia 1.12.6, CUDA.jl 6.3.1, WaterLily 1.8.0, CUDA.functional(), CuArray/KernelAbstractions smoke and WaterLily CUDA extension pass with unchanged Project/Manifest hashes
gates.K0_C: The original W2-T4a analytic job reaches tU/D >= 60, has 2246 steps, finite velocity, pressure and forces, positive drag, stationarity relative drift <= 0.02, and valid VRAM/timing
gates.K0_D: Relative difference of Kaggle and Colab analytic window-mean drag <= 0.0001, fixed before Kaggle measurement; no bitwise equality requirement
gates.K0_E: Two independent Julia processes overlap in time, each pinned to one distinct T4 by CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES, and each window-mean drag differs from the single-GPU Kaggle run by <= 0.000001 relative
gates.K0_F: Kaggle CLI retrieves version-specific output and all named output files match a downloaded SHA-256 manifest

relative_difference_definition: abs(a-b)/max(abs(a),abs(b)); reject zero or non-finite drag
failure_policy: A failed gate remains failed; never relax a bound from the observed result. Save diagnostic output, but do not declare Kaggle the primary backend.
scope_exclusions: no sampled sphere, grid convergence, v16 physics, gradient, topology or optimizer claim
no production backend switch before all K0 gates and W1g pass
